fields.caption_bottom: Review 10–20 AI-generated synths daily before they review Apple

narrative_summary: Apple’s overwhelmed review team faces 10–20 AI-generated synth apps daily, until the apps start reviewing Apple instead.
rationale: Candidate 2 uses the story’s concrete 10–20-app daily flood while adding a clean, genuinely unexpected reversal: the apps review Apple. The One Does Not Simply template suits the impossible task, and the closing threat supplies a real punchline rather than merely restating the backlog.
story_title: AI is turning Apple's app review process into a nightmare for synth developers
place: at a pop-up ad that won't close
